description: Admission in Hospital by Sector (Government / Private) is a data set listed in Bahrain Open Data Portal (data.gov.bh), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by Ministry of Health. The total number of patient admissions to hospitals, classified according to the sector to which the hospital belongs, whether public or private. Notes: 1. Data for the Government Sector for 2018, 2019, 2021, and 2022 do not include King Hamad University Hospital (KHUH). 2. Data for 2023 include all government and private hospitals. 3. Coverage: Bahrain. The portal files it under the publisher Ministry of Health. Its tags are Health, Admission. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-08-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support health-facility access and emergency-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-gov-bh-portal.
